blocks.x: Architecture, security posture and audit evidence for EEMS Platform — decision intelligence hub from Achala IT Solutions.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (one governed entry point with SLA guarantees, versioned decision policies with effective-dating and simulation, shadow scoring and incremental traffic shifting); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (full input/model/policy snapshots per decision, online feature store with point-in-time correctness); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

Nexus runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys, full audit export and evidence packs mapped to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and model-risk expectations. Decision policies, model versions and feature states are immutable artifacts — the replay trail is cryptographic, not testimonial.

items: platform controls audited; evidence exports mapped to customer audit scopes.
DORA, HIPAA-ready pods, PCI DSS support and GDPR data-residency options where the estate requires them.
NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 control mapping; EU AI Act documentation generated for high-risk deployments.

blocks.x: The control plane is sized for enterprise scale: decision and orchestration paths carry published latency budgets, and the evidence plane writes append-only logs that never sit on the hot path.

items: deployed inside your cloud landing zone; customer-managed keys; your SIEM receives telemetry.
operated by our pods under SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 with quarterly evidence exports.
Twinverse and Sentinel patterns extend to plant, store and site estates with signed boot and 62443-aligned segmentation.

blocks.x: Databricks Feature Store, Kafka/Flink, Redis, OPA, core-system adapters. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are versioned contracts — one schema change propagates to every consumer.
